text:
Sam (CEO): quick founders briefing: three items + tiny metrics note. react if blocking.
Sam (CEO): 1) Policy change: hosted API default retention -> 90 days. Priya & Hana to finalise customer copy and FAQ by Fri COB.
Sam (CEO): 2) Private GA: internal rollout next Wed; invite batch to pilots the week after. Product/Eng confirm onboarding checklist by Mon EOD.
Sam (CEO): 3) Reliability: staging canary exposed a memory growth in batching; rollback done, no prod impact. postmortem scheduled.
Priya - VP Product: ack. I'll draft the customer note and short FAQ. Hana, please add legal phrasing.
Diego - Eng Lead: PR #6102 contains a hotfix for batching. staging redeploy tomorrow AM. will add kv-cache healthchecks.
Morgan (SRE): incident brief: staging OOM at 02:15 UTC due to oversized batch accumulation. Rolled back to v1.23.x at 02:40 UTC. Postmortem Thu 15:00 UTC in #incidents.
Hana (Legal): suggested wording: "Default retention: 90 days; extended retention available under contract." I'll post redlines by Thu AM.
Alex - Head of Sales: prepping a 1-par outreach paragraph for pilots. Priya, can you share by Mon noon?
deploy-bot: rollback v1.24.1 -> v1.23.x initiated by Morgan (SRE) at 02:40 UTC. Log: "ROLLBACK_OK - mem_growth_detected"
Sam (CEO): thanks team. two org asks: A) surface any GA blockers by Mon 09:00 PT; B) if you can't attend the postmortem, add notes to the doc in advance. :thumbsup:
__comments: Single Slack thread string with short messages. No title field per agents.md.
